t: What Wave and Ocean Energy Converters Is
title: What Wave and Ocean Energy Converters Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Wave and ocean energy converters harvest the sea's motion: bobbing buoys, flapping flaps, and oscillating columns turning waves, tides, and currents into electricity — the largest untapped renewable, predictable for days ahead. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Wave and Ocean Energy Converters: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.

Why it matters: The ocean holds terawatts of predictable power; wave energy is solar's steady cousin..
Where it is used: coastal grids, island power, desalination, offshore platforms..
